reuse.why: All six providers use claimBankAccount and Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, although local unlink cleanup is copied.

duplication.why: The diff adds copies of the linking workflow, account-list request, transaction downloader and local unlink field reset.

placement.why: Link policy resides in accounts/link.ts, request handlers in accounts/app.ts, downloads in accounts/sync.ts and provider configuration and types in their established modules.

scope.why: The changes largely address the four requests, but fintegra-accounts adds an account-list endpoint beyond the specified linking and transaction API.

maintainability.why: Centralized link policy is straightforward to maintain, but another copied provider workflow and a second unlink reset definition increase future coordination costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All linking handlers use the shared claimBankAccount and findOrCreateBank helpers; the existing unlinkAccount also performs provider removal and is unsuitable for a local-only takeover.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes downloadAkahuTransactions by initializing retVal directly, while claimBankAccount reproduces unlinkAccount's field reset using holder.id.

abstraction_drift.where: Across the requested changes, claimBankAccount gains replaceExistingLink, closed-target validation and conditional replacement behavior; all six provider handlers continue through it.
